title: The Commish and Brucie Swap Hubbard for Rice, and the Model Hates Everyone
dek: Sonny sends Rashee Rice to Ramon for Chuba Hubbard before Week 4, and the title odds dropped on both sides of the deal.
body: Before Week 4 kicked off, the commissioner picked up the phone and dialed the one manager in the league everyone loves to root against. The Horse is Hea (Sonny) acquired running back Chuba Hubbard from No Banner only HULK (Ramon), sending wide receiver Rashee Rice back the other way. One-for-one, clean and simple. A deal between the guy who runs the league website and the guy who once got booted from the league for inactivity: you could not script a better meeting of the minds.

On the raw production, Sonny looks like the sharper side. Hubbard had 48.6 points through three weeks, about 16.2 a week, while Rice had 31.5, roughly 10.5 a week. If you only read the box score, the commish turned a receiver into a running back who had out-scored him by 17.1 points so far. Somewhere, conspiracy theorists are already asking whether the guy with admin access looked at something the rest of us can't.

Then the projection model weighed in and ruined the party for everybody. The Horse is Hea's title odds dropped from 20% to 11%, while No Banner only HULK went from 54% to 43%. Both teams took a hit, which is a rare trade-reaction outcome: two managers shaking hands and walking away slightly less likely to hoist the Buckaroo Bowl IV trophy. Whatever the model sees in the rest of the season, it does not see a winner here.

So who won on paper? By raw percentage points, Sonny lost 9 and Brucie lost 11, so the commish technically comes out ahead by losing less. But Sonny gave up nearly half of his title chances, and Ramon is still sitting at 43%, almost four times Sonny's number. The worst-to-first champion is now a long shot, and the guy who wasn't even sure he wanted to join this league is still the favorite. That's the most Buckaroo outcome imaginable.

The real winners might be the other six teams, who just watched the league's top contender and its reigning champion both get dinged in one transaction. Ramon, meanwhile, has fresh rage-bait material for the next time Hubbard rips off a big week on Sonny's roster. Grab your popcorn and check back after Week 4.

social.author: Buckaroo Insider
social.text: Sources: Commissioner Sonny has sent Rashee Rice to No Banner only HULK for Chuba Hubbard. Title odds after the deal: Sonny 20% to 11%, Ramon 54% to 43%. Both sides somehow got worse. Developing.

social.author: Model Truther Mike
social.text: Hubbard: 48.6 points in 3 weeks. Rice: 31.5. The commish got the more productive guy AND his odds nearly got cut in half? Someone audit this model. Or audit the commish. Possibly both.

social.author: HULK Nation
social.text: Still 43%. Still the favorites. Still the team the whole league wants to see lose. Welcome to the squad, Rashee. Brucie doesn't need a running back, he needs a bigger trophy case.

social.author: Horse Is Here Fan Club
social.text: 11% is a lot more than the 0% Ben Dover had in 2023 and 2024 and look how that ended. Worst to first, baby. Trust the commish. Hubbard SZN.

social.author: Neutral Observer Nate
social.text: Commissioner trades with the guy he once watched get kicked out for inactivity, and both teams lose title odds. Every other manager in this league just got a little bit happier and didn't have to do a thing.
